'''Imperial Central Command''' was a complex that served as headquarters of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during its [[Dictatorship/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Corellia|occupation]] led by [[Darth Decimus]].<ref name="Codex" />

Located in the complex's upper levels was<ref name="GD" /> '''Decimus's Rise''',<ref name="Codex" /> which served as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] offices.<ref name="GD" /> The former offices of Corellia's [[Trade Tariff Service]], Decimus&mdash;who masterminded the invasion and commanded Imperial forces on Corellia&mdash;established his command here in the [[Governmental Sector|government district]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tarandon]]'s recommendation. The chambers of Darth Decimus's Rise were thus re-appropriated into an Imperial fortress without delay.<ref name="Codex" />
